\mxunit{enrichment-euler-trails-problems}{Routes without lifting the pencil}
\mxsubtitle{High school · graphs and logic \textperiodcentered{} Synthesis problem \textperiodcentered{} 06}

\begin{problem}[Investigate, justify, conclude]
A network has edges AB, BC, CD, DA, AC and CE, each 1 km long. Starting at A, visit every edge at least once and return to A. Which vertices have odd degree? What is the minimum route length? Give a route attaining it.
\end{problem}
